note: Presets are saved parameter sets for the same animation; they do not count as additional animations. All content is fictional and illustrative. The exploded view takes the aligned pair apart: card A (original decision), card B (confirmatory decision as supplied), their result fields and the neutral alignment guide. Only the supplied relationships are drawn; a plain relation has no arrowhead and nothing is causal unless the author supplies it (a sequence link is captioned 'as configured (illustrative)'). The printed results are supplied text and never change; no doctrine on what a confirmation means. Brief fields: decisions, grounds, routes, outcomes, elements, relationships, focusElement, relationLabels and traversalOrder are editable.
